'''Malik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Malik lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Byrsym]], where he worked as a [[Translator/Legends|translator]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces there. He was an acquaintance of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Nib Nubbu]] and had a deep, unrequited love for Nubbu's sister, [[Numa Nubbu]].
